ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: When poll_read_body decodes a trailers frame on a chunked request body, the reading state should transition to Reading::KeepAlive (body completed) instead of Reading::Closed, allowing the HTTP/1 connection to be reused for subsequent requests.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'fix(http1): allow keep-alive for chunked requests with trailers' and body state: 'poll_read_body in conn.rs incorrectly transitioned to Reading::Closed instead of Reading::KeepAlive, preventing connection reuse. Trailers signal body completion (same as a final data frame at EOF), so the connection should remain eligible for keep-alive.' Regression test http1_trailer_recv_keep_alive verifies second request succeeds on same TCP stream; maintainer approved as a simple fix.
